_meta.identity_contract: affix_id is identity; names are presentation and may be empty or repeated.
_meta.roll_mapping_contract: tiers[].rolls[property_index=0] = tier minRoll/maxRoll; property_index=i+1 = tier extraRolls[i].
_meta.value_scale_contract: All roll values are the raw serialized floats, unscaled. No x100 or divide-back transform is applied. Display/percentage semantics are a property-definition concern (PropertyList), not an export concern.
